summary: 针对机场周边及进近航线等敏感净空区域进行7x24小时全时段护卫，阻断“黑飞”无人机干扰航班正常起降的威胁。采用无线电侦测与压制联动，配合导航欺骗，确保机场净空安全，保障民用航空秩序。
summary_en: Providing 24/7 protection for sensitive clearance areas such as airport surroundings and approach routes, blocking 'black-flight' UAVs from interfering with normal takeoff and landing. Linkage of wireless detection, suppression, and navigation deception ensures airport clearance safety and maintains civil aviation order.

detail_html:
机场防护详解

机场是反无人机的高敏感区域，对反制设备的频率管控要求极高。我们的系统在干扰非法无人机的同时，不影响塔台通信与波道导航。

  • 保护起降净空区域
  • 多手段联动响应
  • 实时记录与存证
detail_html_en:
Airport Defense Details

Airports are highly sensitive areas for anti-UAV operations, requiring extreme precision in frequency control. Our system neutralizes illegal drones without interfering with tower communications or navigation beacons.

  • Protecting takeoff/landing clearance
  • Multi-layered linkage response
  • Real-time recording and evidence storage
